structured_output.what_is_happening: This is one of about 10 or more "p(doom)" copycat tokens launched within roughly 40 minutes. They all appear to trade on the same tweet from Eliezer Yudkowsky (allTheYud); "p(doom)" is AI-safety slang for the chance that AI causes catastrophe. This contract launched through a Meteora virtual curve and migrated immediately. It hit about $842k at its peak within minutes and is now about $236k. It is down 36% in the last 5 minutes and about 62% over 15 minutes. Bigger same-name pools already exist: ARPw ($533k), Exk6 ($789k) and 6yEN ($464k), and ARPw and Exk6 are carrying more volume.

narrative.description: A p(doom) / Yudkowsky / AI-doom meme. The theme is culturally real and tied to a live tweet, but it has been split across many identical tickers.
narrative.why_spreading: A tweet from a famous figure started a ticker race. Bots and degen traders buy every new contract that uses the name.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the name and a link to the tweet connect it. It launched later than several siblings, and there is no DexScreener profile and no official endorsement.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Earlier or larger P(DOOM) contracts: ARPwPP ($533k market cap, $1.7M hourly volume), Exk6 ($789k), 6yEN ($464k), 3Voo ($555k but no liquidity), DrqtBK (earliest, now dead), plus several that have already been rugged or zeroed.

authenticity.evidence: There are 2,098 unique buyers but only 94 unique sellers. That points to a few wallets doing repeated dumping or bot selling into broad retail buying. GMGN flags 52 bundlers and 12 snipers, with bundlers holding about 12% of the top-trader share. The dev wallet has already exited (creator_close). The link goes to a usepaid.app page, not a project site. No paid boosts are recorded.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data is available, so I cannot see whether the tweet or any influencer points to a particular contract.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked (danger) and few LP providers, which conflicts with GMGN's lp_burn_ratio of 1.0
One unlabeled holder has 80%, probably the Meteora pool but unconfirmed. Second holder has 8%
Down 62% from its high in 15 minutes, with sellers still active
Split across at least 10 same-name contracts, with larger siblings pulling flow away
Liquidity of $35k against a market cap of $236k

structured_output.counterargument: The Yudkowsky tweet is a strong, catchy cultural hook, and 2,000+ unique buyers in 15 minutes is real breadth. If this contract becomes the community's choice, a bounce back toward the $842k high (about 3.5x) is possible, and copycat meta coins often swing sharply both ways.

structured_output.thesis: This is a late, non-canonical copycat in a crowded ticker race. It is already down 62% from its high, the dev has exited, the LP is flagged as unlocked, and sellers are concentrated. Larger siblings dominate the flow, so another 2x from the entry price is unlikely. Fading, sliding lower or being rugged is the more likely outcome.
